parameters.query:
SELECT 'siem_alert' as source, event_id as id, rule_desc as event,
       src_ip as actor, agent_name as target, severity,
       processed_at as event_time
FROM bt_alert_log
WHERE processed_at BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
ORDER BY processed_at;

SELECT 'auth_log' as source, event_id as id, rule_desc as event,
       src_ip as actor, username as target, severity,
       processed_at as event_time
FROM bt_alert_log
WHERE rule_id IN ('5501','5502','5503','5710','5711','5712','18107','18108')
  AND processed_at BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
ORDER BY processed_at;
INSERT INTO dfir_timelines (case_id,analyst,total_events,spike_count,first_event,last_event,built_at) VALUES ('CID','analyst',0,0,NOW(),NOW(),NOW()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

meta.description: Manually triggered. Queries SIEM, auth logs, DNS, process logs for a case. Builds unified timeline. Exports to Jira.
